seo__search_description: Free hot lunches Tuesday to Thursday at Oakdene Kitchen, 9/2 Dale Street, Fairfield. Open to people experiencing hardship.
hero__intro: Hot, nutritious meals in a safe and welcoming space.
intro_service_details__heading: A welcoming meal and a friendly face
intro_service_details__text: The Oakdene Kitchen provides free hot lunches to people doing it tough. We believe everyone deserves access to a warm, nutritious meal in a safe environment — and a chance to connect with others.
intro_service_details__text_3: People experiencing food insecurity, on low income, homeless or at risk, or anyone doing it tough.
image_strip__image_alt: Oakdene Kitchen volunteers with prepared food
image_strip__image_alt_2: Inside the Oakdene Kitchen dining room
image_strip__image_alt_3: Volunteer serving meals at Oakdene Kitchen
how_it_works__text: On your first visit, one of our team members will sit down with you to find out more about your situation and needs so we can understand how to support you best.
eligibility__list: Current Centrelink statement showing total income below $1,200 per fortnight, including any other subsidies or rental support shown on the statement
Proof of ID with photo-based evidence (driver's licence, passport, etc.)
Updated statement to be provided monthly showing any changes to income or benefits
important_note__text_2: If you choose to use Oakdene Kitchen support, you will no longer be able to be a member of Fairfield RSL.
community_guidelines__text: We ask that you treat others with respect. Aggressive or abusive behaviour is not accepted. Staff may refuse entry if guidelines are not followed.
volunteer_callout__text: We are always looking for volunteers to help us run the Kitchen. Whether it is helping prepare food, serving meals, or providing a friendly presence — every contribution makes a real difference.
volunteer_callout__text_2: If you would like to get involved, please get in touch.
data__what_we_offer: Friendly, safe space to eat together
Connection with staff, volunteers and community supports
